        d = ppl[phase]["0.2"]
        print(f"  {phase}: dense={d['dense']:.4f}, attn={d['attn']:.4f}, kv={d['kv']:.4f}, both={d['both']:.4f}")

print()

print()
print("=== Phase Stats ===")

    print(f"  {k}: {v}")
